# AvalancheDynamics

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The propagation of cascading neural activity events (avalanches) whose size and duration follow power-law distributions, a hallmark of self-organized criticality. Provides a measurable metric for evaluating and tuning the computational state of TCC/iNEST networks to ensure optimal information processing and fault tolerance.
